description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single-target Lightning/NE summon magical attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], & Crystal Force Mode: Garnet (Lightning) to the user
Crystal Force I: 6 single-target Lightning/NE summon magic attacks (6.6 each) capped at 19999, inflicts [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)]; Crystal Force II: Grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Quick Cast 2], [50% DEF/RES Pierce 2] [Quick ATB 1] to user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
